## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem and what a user will see after this change.
Link an issue when there is one.

## Validation

List relevant tests and manual checks, including Windows/GPU/input hardware for
rendering or tracking changes. State what remains untested. Add before/after
screenshots for UI changes, using artwork approved for repository documentation.

## Reviewer notes

Describe compatibility, saved-profile migration, API changes or performance costs
that a reviewer needs to assess. Delete this section if none apply.

- [ ] The change is focused and the relevant documentation/help is updated.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior, or I explained why new tests are unnecessary.
- [ ] No credentials, private profiles, SDK binaries or unapproved artwork are included.
- [ ] I have requested a reviewer other than myself.

Before merging: one independent approval, all checks green for the current revision,
and review conversations resolved. See [the review policy](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
